items.synopsis: The rpd process crashes after BGP configuration commits involving group-split-size and RIB-sharding
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, configuring "group-split-size" with BGP RIB-sharding(Border Gateway Protocol Routing Information Base Sharding) can lead to a crash in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) when a route update for a non-negotiated NLRI(Network Layer Reachability Information) is received in the update thread. This occurs if the NLRI is targeted at other BGP peers within the group that have negotiated it.

items.synopsis: BGP Prefix-SID Label collision causing RPD crash
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, In Segment Routing the RPD ( Routing Protocol Daemon ) crash was observed due to different prefixes were trying to use same label, when Bgp prefix SID ( Segment Identifier ) feature was configured and labels were derived using the SID index.

items.synopsis: The 'bbe-smgd' process crashes in BNG with APM environment when loopback interface is moved/removed from a routing-instance through cli
items.description: On Junos MX platforms which supports 'subscriber-management', in a BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) with APM (Address Pool Manager) address allocation environment having "domain-profile" configuration with "dhcp-gateway-address-last-octet" knob enabled, when a loopback interface is moved/removed from a routing-instance through cli, "bbe-smgd" crash can be observed. The existing traffic is unaffected due to this issue, however, new subscriber logins and logout will be impacted if "bbe-smgd" is not running.

items.category: QOS issues in EVO for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: ECN CE bit is not set in an EVPN-VxLAN scenario
items.description: On QFX5130/QFX5700 platforms, in Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN (EVPN-VxLAN) scenario, the Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) Congestion Experienced (CE) bit will not be set for ECN-capable traffic when there is congestion. Since the CE bit is not set, packets will be dropped.

items.synopsis: Commit can fail if apply-path contains pattern-matching tokens other than the wildcard <*>
items.description: When the apply-path contains pattern-matching tokens other than the wildcard < >, prefix list validation may fail, causing the commit to fail.

items.synopsis: Firewall filter IP precedence matches incorrectly when a range of values is configured
items.description: Firewall filter IP precedence match incorrect when a range of values is configured. With matching only one precedence value, either (6 or 7) as an example, packets match the correct term and the action is achieved. Or when configuring a firewall family filter to match the precedence value, for example, of internet-control (6) and net-control (7) in the same term, packets do not match the correct term, and the action is not achieved.

items.synopsis: application rpd-agent may restart with a coredump after interface related event changes.
items.description: The rpd-agen application may restart either immediately or latently - after interface are activate, deactivated, created, or removed.via.

items.synopsis: Slow configuration commit observed on devices with a single Routing Engine (RE)
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms with single RE and the system type is cluster, a commit delay is observed when operating with a single RE. This occurs because the system attempts to synchronize with the second RE by default, but since it's not present, the process waits and causes the delay in commit.

items.synopsis: The rpd EVPN module sends a redundant license message to the license infrastructure
items.description: On Junos platforms, when loading the baseline configuration or during BGP flaps or Routing Instance deactivation, and a large number of Group-Based Policy (GBP) tagged routes are removed, a redundant GBP license update message is sent to the license infrastructure for every route deletion. This issue has no impact on traffic.

items.synopsis: The data plane will be out of sync when migrating to EVPN A/A stitching with Vanila VXLAN (PIM Multicast)
items.description: On MX platforms, to improve the convergence of node failures in EVPN MH interconnects with Data Plane VXLAN, migrating to an Active-Active setup may cause the data plane to become out of sync for ARP entries. The gateway learns the MAC address and advertises it to the peer gateway. However, on the peer gateway, some MAC-IP entries may remain stuck in the 'Unresolved' (Ur) state.

items.category: Common PR category for all EVO AFT based L2 features related issues on Express platforms
items.synopsis: In scale EVPN scenario with IRB, host traffic via IRB will be impacted ICMP, OSPF, BGP and L3 protocols on Junos Evolved OS PTX series platform
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved PTX series platforms, in a scale EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) scenario with IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging), the traffic via IRB will be impacted ICMP, OSPF, BGP and L3 protocols.

items.synopsis: After GRES ptp-spll-lock-state is stuck in ACQUIRING instead of phase aligned. timingd re core is also observed which is not seen in rerun
items.description: After GRES ptp-spll-lock-state is stuck in ACQUIRING instead of phase aligned. timingd re core is also observed which is not seen in rerun

items.synopsis: Simultaneous login by multiple PPPoE subs with same MAC address fails
items.description: On Junos MX platform with subscriber management enabled, simultaneous login by multiple PPPoE subs with same MAC address fails

items.synopsis: Loss of synchronization are observed when SyncE/PTP configurations are changed
items.description: On MX10004 and MX10008 platforms with JNP10K-RE3 and LC480 line cards, when the device is set up with G8275.1 PTP( Precision time protocol) profile or SyncE (Synchronous Ethernet ) and GRES, performing a GRES switchover causes DPLL-2 to go from "lock" to "unlock." This can lead to a loss of synchronization which can disrupt timing-sensitive services like PTP and SyncE.

items.category: MPC11 ULC platform software related issues.
items.synopsis: On MPC11E linecards, Periodic error messages are logged as "Temp sensor DDR4 A failed"
items.description: DDR temp sensor is designed to be used periodically to get temps to send to chassisd. The temp sensors reside may have an intermittent contention that can cause these read failures resulting in DDR4 Temp Sensor Fail" logs on MPC11E linecards.

items.category: Express PFE Tunnels on BX platforms
items.synopsis: Regression: Balerion: transit-traffic-statistics/input-pps is not as expected while verifying FTI tunnel operation with MPLS services.
items.description: Balerion: transit-traffic-statistics/input-pps is not as expected while verifying FTI tunnel operation with MPLS services.

items.synopsis: on QFX5130, duplicate-mac-detect action discard does not work . The action shutdown port should be used instead.
items.description: When duplicate-mac-detect feature is configured, if the mac moves from leaf to network in a VXLAN enviroment, the action discard does not take effect. The mac move is prevented. As an alternate, use the action shutdown port instead which is also one of the supported options.

items.synopsis: Gamora: RLI 60095: PTP lock status moving from INITIALIZING to PHASE ALIGNED
items.description: With T-GM(Timing - Grand Master) enabled system like ACX7024, ACX7348 and ACX7332, when master port link comes up late, then PTP system servo state can move from INITIALIZING to PHASE ALIGNED. This will not cause any issue since when in INITIALIZING state, no PTP packets are sent to down streams devices and in PHASE ALIGNED state, PTP packets are sent with all correct clock parameters. When system moves to directly PHASE_ALIGNED, it is assured that the system is internally locked to phase and frequency of GNSS.

items.category: Category for QFX5K EVO Platform Interface Software
items.synopsis: EVO_REG: SAPPHIRE: Hitting with input-errors and framing-errors on channelizing QSFP56-DD-400GBASE-DR4
items.description: Issue is not related to Sapphire and not related to optics (QSFP56-DD-400GBASE-DR4) as mentioned in the PR synopsis and Description. We encounter this issue is happening on the Marvel Line-side TX on the Hillside. Input Error and Framing are small in number it should not have significant impact on traffic.

items.synopsis: Interfaces may not come up when 40G and 100G xcvrs are used together on the 16x100G PIC of QFX5700
items.description: When 40G and 100G xcvrs are used together on the 16x100G PIC of QFX5700 such that they are connected to the same Broadcom Serdes Core on the PFE side, then one or more of the links from these interfaces may not come up. With this PIC, ports 0-3, 4-7, 8-11 and 12-15 share one Broadcom Serdes Core each.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: VMX :: JDI-REG-VIRTUAL: Observed xml validation failure seen for "show host | display xml validate" and The emitted XML is INVALID.
items.description: "show host" is not properly XMLized. So from a netconf channel the XML output is encapsulated in an tag. If any automation tool plans to use the XML output of this CLI command, it may have to do some logic on its side (as the response is not 100% XMLized)

items.synopsis: JUNOS: Netconf: Edit-config with operation attribute create for existing hierarchy is not working as per RFC 6241
items.description: JUNOS: Netconf: Edit-config with operation attribute create for existing hierarchy is not working as per RFC 6241

items.synopsis: PTX10003-160C FPC may not restart properly on a high scale system
items.description: A PTX10003-160C with high protocols scaling number, its FPC may not restart properly. An example of a high scaling number is a L2VPN gateway with more than 9000 outbound labels.
